description: Source code for Ethernet driver for ESP32 in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, packet transmission/reception, interrupt handling, and PHY link management.

methods.name: eth_esp32_caps
methods.description: Returns the hardware capabilities of the Ethernet interface, supporting 10BASE-T and 100BASE-T.

methods.name: eth_esp32_send
methods.description: Transmits a network packet over Ethernet.

methods.name: eth_esp32_rx
methods.description: Receives a network packet from Ethernet hardware.

methods.name: eth_esp32_rx_thread
methods.description: Thread function handling incoming Ethernet frames, waits on semaphore, processes received packets.

methods.name: eth_esp32_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine for Ethernet, handles receive finish interrupt.

methods.name: generate_mac_addr
methods.description: Generates or retrieves the MAC address for the device.

methods.name: phy_link_state_changed
methods.description: Callback for PHY link state changes, updates link status.

methods.name: eth_esp32_initialize
methods.description: Initializes Ethernet hardware, configures PHY, resets hardware, starts RX thread.

methods.name: eth_esp32_iface_init
methods.description: Initializes network interface, sets MAC address, links PHY callback, and manages link status.
